### Elihu's Arrogance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/elihus-arrogance
Passage: Job 36:1-33
Points:
- Believers must be slow to speak lest rash words cause spiritual harm to others.
- Elihu failed to listen carefully and repeated the false assumption that Job's suffering stemmed from personal sin.
- He exhibited youthful pride by boasting that his words were free from falsehood and perfect in knowledge.
- Access to modern technology and information does not equal true biblical wisdom.
- Christians should remain humble and learn from the faithful generations who came before them.

### The Wonders of His Weather: Sensing God’s Majesty in the Storm
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-wonders-of-his-weather
Passage: Job 36:26–37:24
Points:
- Modern conveniences often cause us to treat storms as inconveniences rather than revelations of God's power.
- Elihu directs Job's focus away from human debate and toward the incomprehensible greatness of the Creator.
- Rain, clouds, and lightning are commissioned and directed by the hand of God.
- Thunder serves as an alarming warning to the unrepentant but assures the redeemed of God's protecting power.
- Pondering the majesty and mysteries of weather humbles our intellect and leads our hearts to worship.
